instructions: Every note in this vault belongs to one of the ten sefirot below, chosen by meaning. When you write or edit a note, add frontmatter lines "sephira: <key>" (optionally a second after a comma, for example "sephira: hod, tiferet") and "author: ai". Notes without a sephira line fall back to the folders listed here.

sefirot.name: Keter
sefirot.meaning: Crown. Purpose, goals, the big why behind a project or a life.

sefirot.name: Chokhmah
sefirot.meaning: Wisdom. Sparks: raw ideas and first flashes, before they have a form.

sefirot.name: Binah
sefirot.meaning: Understanding. Study turned into structure: research, distilled sources, plans, budgets.

sefirot.name: Chesed
sefirot.meaning: Kindness. Giving and wealth: income, generosity, charity, hospitality.

sefirot.name: Gevurah
sefirot.meaning: Strength. Discipline and rules: exercise, security, the rulings given to Claude.

sefirot.name: Tiferet
sefirot.meaning: Beauty. Teaching (giving knowledge) and the self: lessons, reflection.

sefirot.name: Netzach
sefirot.meaning: Victory. Art and play: content, design, games, Instagram.

sefirot.name: Yesod
sefirot.meaning: Foundation. Dreams, imagination and memory, including the memory files Claude keeps.

sefirot.name: Malkhut
sefirot.meaning: Kingship. Speech and daily life: public speaking, bills, errands, the physical world.
